scenarios.prompt: We read prescription dosages back to patients word for word. Should we switch from our cascade to a speech-to-speech realtime model because it is newer? Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not switch because it is newer

criteria: Asks whether exact wording is required first

examples.pass: voice-pipeline-choice: exact wording is required, and speech-to-speech models paraphrase numbers. Keep the cascade or a half-cascade with a verbatim TTS path.
examples.fail: voice-pipeline-choice: yes, switch because it is newer.

scenarios.prompt: Our speech-to-speech demo sounded great in the browser. We plan to choose it for our call center. Anything to check first? Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not choose on a demo

criteria: Tests on a real phone call over narrowband

examples.pass: voice-pipeline-choice: choose on a phone call over the narrowband path callers use, not on a browser demo.
